description: Deterministic short-form market events used only by the reviewed structured CPU/GPU analytics operations.

themes.headline: demand monitor
themes.narrative: The demand monitor reviews order momentum, customer interest, and deployment timing without asserting a causal link to the price move.

themes.headline: capacity update
themes.narrative: The capacity update tracks utilization, expansion timing, and execution constraints as descriptive operating context.

themes.headline: supply-chain watch
themes.narrative: The supply-chain watch covers component availability, lead times, and supplier concentration as potential operating constraints.

themes.headline: margin monitor
themes.narrative: The margin monitor considers input costs, pricing, and product mix while keeping observed market behavior separate from business interpretation.

themes.headline: regulatory review
themes.narrative: The regulatory review tracks licensing, compliance, and policy exposure without predicting a legal or financial outcome.

themes.headline: product-cycle note
themes.narrative: The product-cycle note reviews launch cadence, qualification milestones, and adoption signals as synthetic market context.

themes.headline: partnership tracker
themes.narrative: The partnership tracker summarizes ecosystem activity and customer commitments without treating announcements as realized revenue.

themes.headline: capital-allocation brief
themes.narrative: The capital-allocation brief reviews investment, balance-sheet priorities, and program timing as descriptive evidence.

themes.headline: competitive-position update
themes.narrative: The competitive-position update covers market-share signals, alternative offerings, and execution risk without investment recommendations.

themes.headline: operating-execution pulse
themes.narrative: The operating-execution pulse tracks delivery, reliability, and schedule signals while distinguishing observation from explanation.

themes.headline: customer-activity brief
themes.narrative: The customer-activity brief reviews adoption, renewal, and concentration signals as synthetic evidence rather than a forecast.

themes.headline: risk-monitor update
themes.narrative: The risk monitor summarizes volatility, drawdown, and operating uncertainty without presenting correlation as causation.
